body:
## Outcome

Give HIG a reproducible development workspace that proves it can be consumed outside the current monorepo.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M1: Foundations and architecture · Priority: P0 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Create the agreed packages, apps/docs, a minimal standalone React consumer, an SSR consumer, and an Expo/native example; configure TypeScript, builds, package exports, and workspace commands.
- Resolve React Native peer dependencies in a real native test/example workspace so CI actually exercises native source instead of silently skipping it.
- Create release/build scripts, contributor instructions, issue/PR templates, and a package inventory with required versus optional dependencies.
- Keep example app implementation separate from published runtime artifacts; avoid creating placeholder wrappers for the entire shadcn catalog.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A clean checkout installs and runs documented build, typecheck, lint, and fixture commands; each supported platform has a reproducible smoke path.
- [ ] Packed artifacts install in fixtures using published-style imports rather than workspace aliases or private monorepo paths.
- [ ] SSR import/hydration and a Metro bundle work without loading incompatible platform modules.
- [ ] The native example can run on iOS and Android and CI reports native tests as executed, not skipped.

## Prerequisites

- #4 — Choose the shared package architecture and source-of-truth ownership

## References

- [Native](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui-native)
- [Web](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
title: Bootstrap the HIG workspace and runnable web/native consumer fixtures
